items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: With Sidney Desmond, I went with... I played with Bob Lyons then.

ctx.x: Well, who did you play with after you played with Sidney Desmond?

With Sidney Desmond, I went with... I'm going to make some art out of it. I played with Bob Lyons then. Then I left Bob Lyons and went to the Maple Leaf Band. And then, after the Maple Leaf Band, I went to work at the bungalow. We played a dance at that, not the dance. Yeah, it was a dance. We called it a dance. And then, at the bungalow, I was playing with the Leap Leaf Band. And old man and I was doing for the prizes. He liked it in my drumming and he called me in the back. He said to me, he says, uh... Do you…
Who all was in the band at the bungalow?
